ai_summary: Advik Capital Limited's statutory auditor, M/s KSMC & Associates, has resigned, citing insufficient professional fees due to the company's stated financial constraints and inability to revise remuneration. While the auditor explicitly denies other material reasons or issues with audit evidence, this resignation serves as a red flag regarding Advik Capital's financial health and ability to sustain professional engagements, necessitating the appointment of a new auditor.
